info.text:
About 7 cents of every S&P 500 fund dollar is Nvidia.
Sunday, Nov 8: Nvidia's board opened an independent investigation after reports that CEO Jensen Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence effort.
The board says it has no reason to believe national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised; Nvidia says Huang will keep leading as CEO.
Shares fell about 5% before Monday's opening bell. Our math: about 0.35% off an S&P 500 fund if nothing else moves.
Next: earnings Nov 17.
Sources: Nvidia board statement, CNBC, WSJ, iShares/SPDR holdings.
News and education, not financial advice.
